description: Luchthavens Geluidcontouren is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dit bestand bevat de geluidcontouren van de luchthavens. De geluidcontouren zijn gebaseerd op het maximaal gebruik van de luchthaven volgens het luchthavenbesluit voor de betreffende luchthaven. De geluidsbelasting is weergeven in de dosismaat Lden. Dit is een jaargemiddelde, waarbij de nacht en avond resp. 5 en 10 dB strenger worden beoordeeld. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are downloadable-data, geluidszones, luchtvaart, vliegvelden, wet-geluidhinder. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
